baseline.training_recipe: DSH-A/P8 strict eps2d=0.3, absgrad=True until densify stop, SepSSIM+L1

candidates.name: Exact loss-adjoint / raster-backward boundary fusion
candidates.exactness: Potentially exact; must match frozen L1 + 11x11 Gaussian SSIM semantics and dL/dimage.
candidates.headroom: UNKNOWN_AFTER_STRONG_BASELINE; loss forward currently 20.31% E2E, but existing fused-ssim must be applied first.
candidates.prior_art: Existing fused-ssim and FaCT-GS fuse loss operators, but no audited public CUDA 3DGS path yet found that directly feeds the exact photometric adjoint into raster backward without materializing the image-gradient boundary.
candidates.kill_gate: Remaining physically removable cross-operator work <2.0% E2E after same-semantics fused-ssim baseline.

candidates.name: Densification-stat sink / auxiliary-adjoint fusion
candidates.exactness: Exact if it reproduces absgrad component accumulation, pixel-space scaling, L2 norm, visibility filtering, and running accum/count.
candidates.headroom: Likely modest. Densify+stats phase averages 2.16% E2E; absgrad generation also lives inside backward.
candidates.prior_art: AbsGS/current gsplat compute and expose absgrad; current DefaultStrategy then clones/scales/masks/norms/index_adds it. Direct persistent-state sink not yet established as a paper novelty.
candidates.kill_gate: Combined absgrad-generation + post-backward statistics cost <2.0% E2E in pre-15K windows.

candidates.name: Exact active-interaction / sparse-tail compaction
candidates.headroom: Historical C25 looked large, but C28 found last_ids/warp termination already explain most tail behavior.
candidates.prior_art: Current gsplat has last_ids, active-tile sparse paths and contribution-index utilities; Taming has max-contributor/bucket skipping.
candidates.kill_gate: Historical research already closed this mechanism unless current-main profiling falsifies C28.

candidates.name: Persistent/touched-only gradient zero-init
candidates.headroom: Direct CUDA-event recalibration showed only 0.14-0.36% of backward; <0.2% E2E.

candidates.name: Block-level atomic aggregation
candidates.headroom: Corrected direct-counter model: median ~1.38% E2E, best ~2.57%; not enough as primary.
candidates.prior_art: DISTWAR/Taming/current gsplat already heavily occupy reduction/ownership design space.
candidates.kill_gate: Low corrected headroom + high prior-art crowding.

candidates.name: Backward-optimizer gradient traffic fusion
candidates.prior_art: Fused Adam, SparseGaussianAdam, Faster-GS fused optimizer, and fully fused engines crowd this space.
candidates.kill_gate: Do not implement unless new current-main direct measurement exceeds 2% removable E2E.

candidates.name: Async optimizer/renderer overlap
candidates.exactness: Cross-iteration double-buffer overlap normally exposes stale parameters to the next forward; not accepted as exact without a dependency proof.
candidates.headroom: Historical estimate ~5.6%, but based on overlap model rather than an exact dependency-preserving implementation.
candidates.prior_art: Generic multistream/double-buffer overlap is established systems technique.
candidates.kill_gate: Reject unless a same-iteration last-use schedule proves next forward observes exactly the standard Adam-updated parameters.
